title: Arduino & Embedded
summary: Microcontrollers, GPIO/ADC/PWM/interrupts, sensors, motors, I2C/SPI/UART, robotics, debugging.

docs.summary: GPIO, ADC/DAC, PWM, timers/interrupts, logic levels, level shifting, power limits, and reading a datasheet.
Non-blocking millis() code, debouncing, state machines, serial debug, memory limits, String/watchdog footguns.
Reading pots/temp/ToF/IMU/encoders, driving LEDs/relays/servos/steppers/motors, MOSFETs, flyback diodes, filtering.
UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN — when to use, wiring, addresses/pull-ups/modes/CS, speeds, and debugging.
DC/servo/stepper differences, H-bridge/stepper drivers, PWM speed, encoder closed-loop, PID tuning, power budget.
Systematic bring-up (power->clock->blink->serial->peripheral), meters/analyzers/scopes, noise, brown-outs, HW vs FW.
